'''Shimiese''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] species from [[Shimia/Legends|Shimia]]. Shimiese was a language of snorts, trumpets and intricate vocalizations, adequate to a Pacithhip's vocal structure. [[Written Shimiese]] was pictographic. Most Pacithhips were fluent in both Shimiese and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], although they were only literate in their own language.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
